query:
SELECT v.id, v.name, v.environment,
               COUNT(vv.id) AS "used!"
        FROM vaults v
        LEFT JOIN vault_versions vv ON vv.vault_id = v.id
        WHERE v.owner_id = $1 AND v.deleted_at IS NULL
        GROUP BY v.id, v.name, v.environment
        ORDER BY v.name, v.environment
